description: This Dart source file defines the LockService class, which manages application locking mechanisms using PIN authentication, biometric authentication, and auto-lock policies based on app lifecycle events. It includes secure storage of salted hashes for PIN verification, preferences for biometrics, and lifecycle observation for auto-lock functionality.

classes.name: LockService
classes.description: A service class that manages application lock state, including PIN, biometric authentication, and auto-locking based on app lifecycle.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a PIN has already been configured by verifying stored hash and salt existence.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Returns the current lock state of the application.

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Sets a new PIN by generating a salt, creating a salted hash, and storing both securely.

methods.name: verifyPin
methods.description: Verifies a provided PIN by comparing its hash against the stored salted hash, unlocking on success.

methods.name: enableBiometrics
methods.description: Sets user preference for biometric authentication via SharedPreferences.

methods.name: authenticateWithBiometrics
methods.description: Attempts biometric authentication; unlocks on success if enabled and available.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Manually unlocks the application, typically after successful authentication.

methods.name: observeLifecycle
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle states to implement auto-locking behavior based on duration and state transitions.
